Maruti Suzuki Dz ire, Honda Amaze, Tata Tigor, Hyundai Xcent, Tata Zest, Toyota Etios and equivalent type) along with Driver. The Vehicle should be either petrol or combo of petrol and CNG vehicle. 2. The rates quoted should include all forms of taxes/GST/charges.

3. Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti, Regional Office, Jaipur will bear only the cost of CNG/Petrol for the dista nce actually plied for official use for which a log book will be maintained by the Driver and the offi cial designated by the Deputy Commissioner, NVS, RO, Jaipur will certify the same. The vehicle shall be hired on 24 hours basis for 12 months in a year. 5. Vehicle provided by the seller should be of latest model and not more than 02 years old (as on the l ast date for submission of Bid). 6. The contract will be for a period of two years (from the date of execution/signing of the contract), e xtendable up to 3 years subject to satisfactory service (initial contract for 2 year + 1 year extend ed contract on mutual consent). 7. The Vehicle should have capacity to carry up to 4 persons (excluding driver). 8. Payment will be made on a monthly basis on raising bill in favour of Deputy Commissioner, NVS RO, Jaipur subject to applicable TDS. 9. Vehicle will be parked in the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti, Regional Office, Jaipur premises only at t he risk of the Service Providing Agency/seller. 10. The hired vehicle may be required to carry the personnel of NVS outstation, in any place falling und er the jurisdiction of Regional Office, Jaipur (Rajasthan/ Haryana and Delhi) and also out of the Reg ion i.e. anywhere in India for which no extra charges whatsoever will be paid. The vehicle hired s hall have valid all India taxi permit for entire period of hiring including extended period of contrac t. 11. The vehicle hired shall have valid comprehensive insurance for entire period of hiring including exte nded period of contract. The Insurance of vehicle should be including the insurance of driver and passengers. 12. The fuel consumption average of the vehicle hired shall be got certified from the Company/ authoriz ed dealer of the vehicle. Charges for fuel will be borne by NVS, RO, Jaipur strictly as per the certi fied average. However, average (CNG/Petrol vehicle) of less than 16 KM per litre will not be acce pted. 13. Valid driving license of the driver and character verification by police shall be made available to N VS, RO, Jaipur. 14. The Agency should have to submit valid proof of Bank Account Number, PAN card, GST certificate an d an undertaking that firm has not been blacklisted. 15. One month's hiring cost is required to be deposited by the Agency as ''Security Deposit/Perf ormance Security Guarantee'' in the form of Demand draft in favour of ''Deputy Commissione r, NVS, Regional Office, Jaipur'' Payable at Union Bank of India, Mansarovar, Jaipur. Security Deposit/Performance Security Guarantee can also be deposited online in NVS, Regional Office, Jai pur Account Number 508702010081529 Bank Name- Union Bank of India, Madhyam Marg, Opposite SFS Post Office, Mansarovar, Jaipur, IFSC Code UBIN0574902. 16. Vehicle is to be hired along with driver from the Service Providing Agency/Seller. The rates quoted a bove as hiring charges are including Driver's Salary and all other kind of remuneration of driver. 17. A logbook in the format prescribed by the NVS, RO, Jaipur for each of the journey performed, duly si gned by the Officers/Officials, would be maintained and submitted by the Agency along with the b ills. 18. Actual parking charges, toll taxes of journeys will be reimbursed along with the monthly hiring charg es bills on the submission of Toll Tax receipt/hard copy of message/electronic transaction of pay ment made. 19. The vehicle will remain available in the RO premises for 24X7 basis for the entire contract period. 20. One month's hiring cost is to be deposited by the Agency as ''Security Deposit/Performan ce Security Guarantee which will be refunded after satisfactory completion of the cont

ract. However, deficiency in performance of contractual obligation or non-observance of any ter ms and conditions would entail forfeiture of performance guarantee. 21. The payment shall be made on post monthly basis against a bill duly supported with photocopies of log book signed by the users, for the said month. 22. The payment shall be subject to deduction of TDS as per rules, which is presently @02% +GST TDS @ 2%. 23. The antecedents of drivers to be deployed should be properly verified, identity of the Driver be auth enticated as per Govt. Rules and norms and their details will have to be provided to this office. In case of change of Driver, prior permission of NVS, RO, Jaipur will be required to be taken. The ser vice providing agency shall provide NVS, RO, Jaipur with Insurance No. & UAN No. allotted to driv ers (including their substitutes) under ESI Act, 1948 & EPF & MP Act, 1952 respectively and disch arge all liabilities under extant labour laws and other statutes in respect of them. 24. The Service providing agency should be in a position to provide standby vehicles within an hour of r eporting of any break down to the Agency telephonically. All expenses are to be borne by the Ag ency in case of break-down of a vehicle (s). The taxi charges from the point of break-down are to be borne by the firm to complete the trip. 25. Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One Thousand only) per day will be deducted in case on non-availability of vehicl e/driver. On the day the driver avails weekly off or he remains absent himself from duty for any r eason whatsoever, the substitute driver shall be provided by the Service Providing Agency/Seller at his own cost. 26. No request for escalation in rates would be entertained for whatsoever reasons, during the currency of the contract including extended period of contract. 27. The agency should provide a landline/mobile number on which he or his representative can be cont acted any time (24 hrs.). The driver should also possess the mobile phone. 28. All liabilities arising out of any legal dispute, accidents, challans, etc. shall be borne/paid by the Age ncy. 29. The vehicle to be supplied should be registered in the name of the firm/owner/partner of the service provider agency/seller. 30. The agency will be required to submit the copies of Registration Certificates Insurance papers, PUC, All India Taxi Permits, Driver's Driving License etc. in r/o the vehicle provided in NVS, RO, Jaipur an d originals will retain be by the driver. 31. The vehicle hired shall have valid insurance for entire period of hiring. 32. Copy of valid driving license of the driver and character verification by police shall be made available to NVS, RO, Jaipur. 33. NVS shall reserve the right to cancel/withdraw the hiring contract at any time without assigning any reason thereof. 34. Driver should be in uniform. No compromise will be made by NVS, RO, Jaipur on punctuality, cleanlin ess, obedience, promptness, appearance and behavior of the Driver etc. If the tenderer, at any p oint of time during official duty, fails to perform duties as directed by NVS, RO, Jaipur the contrac t shall be cancelled without any notice and Security Deposit/Performance Security Guarantee ma y be forfeited. 35. In the matter of any disputes, between the parties regarding the terms and conditions of the contrac t and execution thereof, the matter shall be referred to an Arbitrator (s) as may be appointed by the the Deputy Commissioner, NVS, RO, Jaipur for arbitration under the Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996. The Contractor shall not question the decision of the arbitrator (s) on the ground that t he Arbitrator (s) is/are Government servant (s). The decision of the Arbitrator (s) shall be final and binding on both the parties. 36. The vehicles to be provided should be in good condition, not more than 02 year old (as on the last d ate for submission of Bid) and should not have run more than 25000 kms on the date of hiring an d should be fitted with proper upholstery and accessories etc. The drivers should hold the valid d riving license and other statutory documents in original.

37. The payment will be released on post monthly basis on production of bill, in duplicate, after deducti ng Taxes as applicable and after deducting the penalty, if any. 38. A contract agreement with all above terms and conditions, will be signed by successful bidder agenc st nd y (1 Party) and NVS, Regional Office (2 Party) on Non-Judicial stamp paper of Rs.500.00 (to b e purchased in the name of bidder agency and the cost of the Non-Judicial stamp paper will be bo rne by the agency). 39. The Service Provider should follow all the terms and conditions of NVS mentioned in the agreement and related orders/letters. 40. The contract agency shall be required to comply statutory provisions as per service level Agreemen t and packages as mentioned in GeM Portal. 41. The bidder is required to submit following information in the financial bid viz. Brand name of the v ehicle (make, model and variant), type of fuel, monthly hiring charges including all taxes/charges and Driver's Salary and all other kinds of remuneration of driver. 42. The first aid kit and fire extinguisher operational and valid in all respects should be properly availabl e in the hiring vehicle all the time. 43. The Service provider shall ensure that all maintenance works related to the assigned vehicle will be carried out without affecting the service provided to the Samiti. It shall be ensured that all electri cal connections including lights (both back and front), horn, turn indicators, air conditioning and o ther vehicle systems shall be periodically checked and maintained by the service provider to avoi d any inconvenience to the buyer. 44. The service provider shall provide at his own cost proper uniform and badge and photo identity card to the driver in compliance with the Motor Transport Workers Act. 45. The service provider must ensure that all necessary measures are taken by the Driver to ensure pas senger safety by avoiding negligent driving by their driver such as over-speeding, rash driving ve hicle without brakes/defective brakes. 46. The service provider shall be responsible for ensuring compliance with the provisions related to Labo ur Law/Motor Vehicle Act/Minimum Wages Act and other related statutory provisions. All the gov ernment law/orders/GFR etc on the subject matter/bid would be applicable. 47. The service provider shall not deploy or shall discontinue deploying the person (s), if desired by the Buyer and must ensure prompt replacement. 48. In case the successful service provider firm in the bid doesn't accept the work order and doesn't follo w the terms and conditions, the EMD/Bid Security Amount will be seized, along with cancelling the contract and action will be taken to blacklist the firm. 49. After office working hours the vehicle should be parked in office and Vehicle key will be submitted t o Guard room. 50. The All India permit, Pollution Certificate, Comprehensive insurance and other necessary documents are mandatory for hired vehicle. 51. No request for escalation in rates would be entertained for whatsoever reasons during the currency of the contract. 52. The vehicle deployed for duty shall at no point of time carry any person other than personnel author ized by the buyer. 53. The drivers/staff provided by the service provider shall not be deemed employees of the buyer, henc e the compliance of the applicable labour laws and acts/rules/regulations, including Transport Mot or Workers Act as well as other relevant laws will be the sole responsibility of the service provider . 54. Buyer shall not be liable for any damages whatsoever to public property and/or any third person due to any accident arising out of and in the course of deployment of service provider's vehicle. 55. The buyer will in no way be responsible for violation of traffic rules and/or infringement of any other l aw for the time being in force, either by the driver of the vehicle or by the service provider. 56. During the contract period, if the vehicle is seized or detained or requisitioned by Police/Motor Vehicl e Authority or any other authorities for whatsoever reasons that will be at the service provider's ri

sk. 57. Bidder's Experience-The bidder should have provided the same service at least for the last three y ears, ending 31st March of the previous financial year. However, 1/3rd relaxation in prior experience for MSEs & Startups is given. 58. Financial Standing-under all conditions- (A) Average Annual Financial Turnover for Bidders- The average annual financial turnover o f the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be 50% of the estimated cost as mentioned in the tender documents. Howe ver, 1/3rd relaxation in turnover for MSEs & Startups is given (B) Net-worth-The net worth of The Bidder firm should not be negative ending on 31st March o f the previous financial year, and also should have not eroded by more than 30% (thirty p ercent) in the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year. 59. Forms of Security Bid Security/EMD-In compliance to sub-clause 6.1.1-1 Bid Security of Manual of Procurement of Goods-2024 and Rule 170 of GFR-2017 Bid Security, the Bid security/EMD is kept@3% of estimated cost. Exemption of EMD: sub-clause 6.1.1-1 Bid Security of Manual of Procurement of Goods- 2024 and Rule 170 of GFR-2017 Bid Security, Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) as defin ed in the MSE Procurement Policy issued by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium E nterprises (MSME) and registered Startups as recognized by 1) The Department for Promo tion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) (Please refer to para 1.11.2-4-a) are exempt fro m payment of EMD. In case the bidder falls into these categories, the bidder should furnis h a certified copy of its valid registration details. Except for MSEs, this exemption is valid f or the trade group and monetary value of registration only. Bidders claiming exemption of EMD under this Rules (170 of GFR) are however required to submit a signed Bid securin g declaration accepting that if they withdraw or modify their Bids during the period of v alidity, or if they are awarded the contract and they fail to sign the contract, or to submit a performance security before the deadline defined in the request for bids document, the y will be suspended for the period of 12 months from being eligible to submit Bids for te nders of NVS, RO, Jaipur. Note: Exemption under MSME policy shall be admissible only to eligible Micro and Small Enterprises registered for the relevant category of goods/services being procured. Traders, resellers, distributors, dealers, or authorized agents who are not themselves regi stered MSE manufactures/service providers for the tendered item/service shall not be eligi ble for such exemption. 2) Forfeiture of EMD A bidder’s bid security shall be forfeited if the bidder withdraws or amends its bid or impair s or derogates from the tender in any respect within the period of validity of the tender or if the s uccessful bidder fails to furnish the required performance security or to sign the contract within the specified period. 60. Attributes of driver should be as under: 1. The document of driver-Aadhaar Card, Qualification, Police verification certificate and perma nent address and local address. 2. The Service Provider would be bound by the conditions with regard to police verification of t he deployed staff and their medical fitness. 3. The driver age not less than 21 and not more than 55 years. 4. The driver must be in a clean uniform and must follow normal etiquette and good behaviour

and must be teetotalers and not-smoker. 5. The driver have to fill the logbook daily and logbook will be verified by concerned Incharge o fficers of NVS, RO, Jaipur. 6. The driver should always report for duty in proper uniform with ID card. 7. The driver educational qualification must be at least 10 class passed. 8. The driver will always be polite and follow instruction of the officers. 61. Following documents must be submitted, failing which bid shall be rejected: a) GST Registration b) Pan Card c) Bank Account Number d) Non-blacklisting certificate. e) Valid certificate of MSME/Startup if bidder is MSME/Startup. f) EMD deposit evidence (if bidder is not MSME/startup) 62. All disputes arising out of this tender/bid notice shall be subject to Jaipur jurisdiction only. .
